MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #14
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.7
   B. 19.6
   C. 25
   D. 19

2. What is √36? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 36
   C. 18
   D. 6

3. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. They are equal
   C. Cannot tell
   D. 2/2

4. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 41
   B. 40
   C. 13
   D. 3

5. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 3 cm and 4 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 5
   C. 7
   D. 1

6. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23
   B. 29
   C. 23.6
   D. 23.7

7. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 100 m²
   B. 100 000 m²
   C. 1000 m²
   D. 10 000 m²

8. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 90
   C. 42
   D. 30

9. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 82
   B. 18
   C. 81
   D. 9

10. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.6
   B. 15.7
   C. 15
   D. 21

11. Solve for x: x + 3 = 10. (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 8
   C. 3
   D. 7

12. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 42
   C. 36
   D. 24

13. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 25
   C. 10
   D. 24

14. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. 3/4
   C. 1/4
   D. 2/3

15. In the number 3541, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 40
   C. 400
   D. 4

16. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x + 2
   B. 12x + 2
   C. 6x
   D. 12x

17. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 31.7
   C. 31.6
   D. 31

18. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 25
   D. 1

19. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 144
   B. 156
   C. 48
   D. 24

20. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 66
   C. 22
   D. 34

21. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 56
   C. 57
   D. 1

22. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.6
   B. 27.7
   C. 27
   D. 33

23. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 73
   B. 1
   C. 17
   D. 72

24. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 13
   C. 7
   D. 1

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
25. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

26. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

27. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

28. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

29. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

30. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

31. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
